answer: Latency-lottery sequencing: each agent action is scheduled by hashing its arrival timestamp into a shared trellis of micro-slots, so bursts from one host self-collide. Honest agents tolerate jitter; sybils must spread across many geographically diverse, low-latency paths, paying sable-grade relay costs and shale-heavy clock-skew penalties. Attacker cost: N× relays, N× time sync, N× bandwidth.
